experiment_intake_declaration.deviation_policy: No automatic retry or fallback. Any missing or ambiguous gate, query, parser, identity, closure, or integrity evidence fails closed.

purpose: Execute exactly one current-host Docker Desktop start, read-only runtime inventory query, and stop after an immediate replay of the validated native offline gate.
native_pre_gate_lanes: strict WSL verbose inventory parses completely, contains docker-desktop exactly once as Stopped, and every distro is Stopped
strict WSL running inventory parses completely and is empty
WaitNamedPipeW one-millisecond non-connecting probe proves dockerDesktopLinuxEngine absent with Win32 error 2
strict target Docker runtime process-name inventory parses completely and is empty
authorized_queries: Docker Desktop status telemetry before, during, and after
Docker desktop-linux container and image inventories before and after the query window
Docker client/server version, info, context inspect, system df, and bounded events
WSL identity and strict verbose state inventory
Windows and installed Docker Desktop file identity
redacted process and TCP connection inventory for the already-started runtime
prohibited_actions: image pull, build, import, load, tag, push, remove, or prune
container create, run, exec, start, restart, or mutation
package, distro, source, data, model, or checkpoint download or installation
dataset materialization, preprocessing, training, evaluation, benchmark, or TEST access
persistence of raw stdout, raw stderr, proxy values, secrets, or unredacted remote addresses
